model.name: 3-way diff/merge VIEW (left/right/center panes)
model.description: The editor shows THREE panes: left + right (the two compared versions) + center (the merged result), with line-level diff highlighting between left<->center and right<->center.

discoverySource.note: R30.6 sub-feature (1/5) of the 3-way diff/merge editor. Scenario-first; planner tasks T30.6.1.

model.crossRefNote: 3-way diff/merge editor (R30.6 umbrella) to resolve the OOSH version issue. Class DiffMergeEditor (architect wires).

acceptanceCriteria.text: Three panes: LEFT + RIGHT (the two compared versions) + CENTER (the merged result), side by side.
Line-level diff highlighting between left<->center AND right<->center (changed/added/removed lines marked).
